senses.sense_definition: A type of tin-glazed earthenware ceramic, used domestically for tableware and in architecture as a decorative material.

examples.text: The historic building features a colorful <w>faience</w> facade that has survived for over a century.
Collectors often seek out antique French <w>faience</w> plates decorated with floral patterns.

senses.sense_definition: Beads, figurines, or ornaments made from glazed non-clay ceramic material (frit), especially from ancient Egypt and the Mediterranean.

examples.text: Archaeologists uncovered several ancient necklaces composed of brilliant blue <w>faience</w> beads in the tomb.
The museum display highlights small Egyptian figures molded from glittering <w>faience</w>.
